props.title: St Julien Hotel & Spa
props.lede: St Julien is in downtown Boulder, a block off Pearl Street, and its lawn and terraces look straight up at the Flatirons.

headingText.html: Live music is part of the hotel already. There are bands on the terrace from Wednesday to Saturday, and jazz at the holiday buffets.

props.title: Event spaces at St Julien Hotel & Spa

rows.text: The Xanadu Ballroom is about 4,100 sq ft with 14-foot ceilings, for banquets of up to 300 and receptions of up to 360. It divides into three, and there’s about 2,900 sq ft of pre-function space outside.
The lawn is about 2,400 sq ft of grass with views of the Flatirons, for banquets of up to 200 and receptions of up to 275.
The Redgarden Lower Terrace holds dinners of up to 80, and the Redgarden Court and Upper Terrace hold receptions of up to 100 and 75.

rows.term: Jill’s and the Honey Onyx Room
rows.text: Jill’s, the hotel’s restaurant, holds private events of up to 140, and the Honey Onyx Room holds up to 40.

props.title: Live music for a ceremony on the lawn or the terraces
props.lede: They’re the spaces for the ceremony and the cocktail hour, under the Flatirons.

props.title: Live music in the Xanadu Ballroom
props.lede: It’s the space for wedding receptions, company dinners and holiday parties.

rows.text: Our acts bring their own sound system, sized to the space. The hotel also has AV in-house.
The hotel’s garage has a 7-foot height limit, so we plan where the act parks and unloads ahead of time.
The hotel caters events in-house, and it has its own wedding specialist.
The terrace has bands from Wednesday to Saturday, so we’ll plan your music around it.
Boulder limits amplified sound outdoors late at night, so an outdoor event wraps up its loud music and moves inside.
The lawn and terraces are outdoors, so we’ll plan the music with an indoor backup in mind.

props.title: Ask about your date at St Julien Hotel & Spa.
props.lede: Send us your date, and we can put together live music for your event at the hotel, from strings on the lawn to a full band in the Xanadu Ballroom.
